name: manual_5c2cd9
claim: A bounded Markdown taxonomy checker must ignore fenced examples, retain escaped pipes as cell content, and still reject malformed separators and row widths. Mutation-check negative tests by removing each guard separately; a passing happy path does not prove the guard is exercised.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 5792983379 exposed false acceptance of fenced-only tables and rejection of valid escaped cells. Fix b6c27b699d81b29b6138122f8ff48a8e1473a39a passed17 CLI tests; removing either format guard made its new test fail. https://github.com/diazMelgarejo/orama-system/pull/475#issuecomment-6671227763
